verdict.rationale: Jeeves documents a public developer API platform covering cards, payments, transactions and expense data. The docs describe mTLS and OAuth 2.0 authentication, concrete endpoints such as POST /v1/cards/transactions, a Boleto API, signed webhooks, and TypeScript and Python SDKs, so an AI-native user can drive the product programmatically. Missing for 10: no machine-readable OpenAPI/Swagger spec found (all probe paths returned 404), only one concrete endpoint evidenced beyond the Boleto API, and no independent or hands-on corroboration of the API in use.
